name: Estelle
summary: ISO formal description technique (ISO 9074) for OSI protocols in which a specification is a hierarchy of modules, each a communicating extended finite-state machine whose transitions are written in a Pascal-based notation; it exchanged messages through interaction points and channels.

level_notes.1: The ISO 9074 standard is paywalled and no longer widely distributed; the 1987 Budkowski/Dembinski introduction is the standard reference.
level_notes.0: Historical tools (EDT, Pet/Dingo, Open Estelle) are no longer maintained; an early Estelle-to-C compiler report is linked.
